header.heading: Spending & payouts
header.subheading: See what you paid, what came back, and your net result.

empty.startTitle: Start with an account or an expense
empty.startBody: Add the firm and attempt you want to track, then record fees and actual payouts. You can also log shared firm costs before linking an account. No firm, fee schedule or payout rules are preloaded.

filters.datesNote: Dates apply to cash received or paid. Account history and pending requests cover all dates.
filters.dateOrderError: The start date must be on or before the end date.

summary.awaitingNote: All dates · Excluded from received cash
summary.mixedCurrencies: Currencies are never added together. Choose one above for charts and detailed totals.

search.label: Search prop records
search.placeholder: Search firm, account, reference or status

breakdown.toggleNote: Net cash trend, firm returns, expense categories, account progress, renewals and monthly records
breakdown.chooseCurrencyChart: Choose a currency to plot cash returns.
breakdown.buildHistory: Record spending or a payout receipt to build your cash history.
breakdown.chartNote: Starts at zero for the selected period. Payouts + refunds − expenses − reversals.
breakdown.passRateNote: {passed} passed / {total} passed or breached evaluation phases. Active and voluntarily closed phases are excluded; this is not a whole-challenge success rate.
breakdown.progressNote: Link accounts to journal trades from account details. Funding sizes are descriptive and never counted as your cash investment.
breakdown.noMovements: No cash movements in this selection.
breakdown.noExpenses: No recorded expenses in this selection.
breakdown.breakdownNote: Gross spending by category. Refunds appear separately in the summary.
breakdown.renewalsNote: Reminders do not create expenses or charge your card. Update the next date after reviewing a renewal.

payouts.intro: Open requests always remain visible. Completed, rejected and cancelled requests use the request-date filter. Expected amounts are after your share and withheld fees; actual amounts come only from receipts.

ledger.intro: Expenses and refunds use cash dates; payout rows use request dates. Export cash CSV for individual settlement dates. Payout requests do not count as income.

methodology.title: How these numbers work
methodology.p1: Net cash return = actual payout receipts − payout reversals + expense refunds − spending. Net spend = spending − refunds. ROI = net cash return ÷ net spend; it is unavailable when net spend is zero or negative.
methodology.p2: Amounts use each currency’s minor units. Currencies are never converted or combined automatically. Your firm’s actual approval, payout rules and bank statement remain authoritative.
methodology.p3: Past attempts, breached accounts and archived accounts stay in cash returns. Shared firm costs are included in firm totals but are not silently allocated to individual accounts.
methodology.p4: Requests and reminders never move money. This tracker does not place trades, connect banks, infer payout eligibility, or change journal trading P&L. JSON exports in Settings include these records and their audit history; copy the data directory to preserve attachment files too.

account.description: Keep each evaluation, reset attempt and funding phase as its own record. Account size is nominal capital, not money you spent.
account.renewalNote: A reminder only. Record an expense when charged; nothing is charged or added automatically.

entry.payoutDescription: A request is not income. Record actual bank receipts separately, including partial payments. This does not request a payout from your firm.
entry.expenseDescription: Record cash that actually changed hands. Include taxes and fees in the amount paid. Do not duplicate trading commissions already included elsewhere.
entry.splitNote: If your amount is already after the firm split, enter 100% and only fees still to be deducted. Never deduct the split twice.
entry.refundLinked: Linked expense: {id}. Refunds reduce costs and are shown separately from payout income.

receipt.title: Record payout cash movement
receipt.description: Record the actual net amount credited or returned in {currency}. If your bank converted currencies, use the statement's original-currency amount; this tracker does not invent an exchange rate.
receipt.note: Keep the request open for partial payments. Once the final payment arrives, edit the payout status to Completed; a difference from the expected amount remains visible.

change.archiveDescription: Archiving hides the account from the active list. Its cash history remains in returns. You can restore it later.
change.voidDescription: Voided records stay in the audit trail and are excluded from cash totals. They can be restored. Voiding a payout also excludes its receipts.

import.title: Import prop cash CSV
import.description: Import settled expenses, refunds and net payouts. Preview validates every row; an import is all-or-nothing and repeated stable IDs are skipped.
import.instructions: Use kind expense, refund or payout; date YYYY-MM-DD; positive amount in currency units. A payout amount is cash already received after splits and fees. Payouts need account_id from an account’s Details. A refund’s expense_id references its original CSV row ID. Put expenses before their refunds. This is not a broker statement importer.
import.tooLarge: Use a CSV up to 2 MB / 1,000 rows.

cash.spentNote: All fees, subscriptions and other costs
cash.pendingNote: Pending requests are tracked separately below.
cash.chooseCurrencyCompare: Choose a currency in Filters to compare spending and payouts.
cash.startComparison: Record an expense or a payout receipt to start your comparison.
cash.comparisonNote: Refunds reduce your net cost. Hover a month for refunds and the final net amount.
